text:
matt: Heads-up — canary for release v3.5.3 showing p95 jump in embeddings service, deploy-bot flagged it. Thinking manual rollback or pin traffic. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: Canary health: p95 latency +22% vs baseline, error rate +0.6%, auto-rollback not triggered (threshold 30%).

sophia: Can we wait 10m for more telemetry? Is spike correlated with specific kernel flag?

kevin: We saw the quant-opt kernel flag toggled in this rollout. If that's the culprit, a partial rollback of that flag might be faster than full version revert.

jess: Any dedicated customers on this canary slice or is it all hosted? Need to assess CS impact.

matt: No dedicated pools in this slice; mix of hosted production traffic. @nina any user-facing errors reported from support?

nina: No direct tickets yet. I'll pre-warn CS and set up watch. Recommend we decide quickly to avoid noisy telemetry.

sophia: I'm leaning manual rollback to v3.5.2. Auto rollback would wait for a larger threshold and could increase user impact. Recommend pin + quick validation.

kevin: Agreed. Proposed exec plan: 1) Pause rollout traffic for canary, 2) pin embeddings service to v3.5.2, 3) flip quant-opt=off and rerun a narrow canary, 4) if stable, resume rollout; else full revert and postmortem. Who can run the pin?

matt: I can run the pin. Command I'll use: `./deployctl pin --service=embeddings --version=v3.5.2 --scope=canary`

deploy-bot: Received manual pin request from matt, executing — emitting events to #deploy-log. ETA ~90s.

oncall-bot: Creating incident INC-2026-145, notifying SRE rota for 2h.

jess: I'll draft a short status blurb for #customer-updates and message CS with the rollback plan if we execute.

matt: Pin in progress...

deploy-bot: Pin completed. Traffic split reverted to v3.5.2 for canary. Observability: p95 trending back toward baseline.

kevin: Nice. Next step: flip quant-opt=off on a narrow slice (5%) and watch for 20m. If stable, widen. If not, keep v3.5.2 and schedule full revert + PR revert.

sophia: Sounds good. Postmortem owners: kevin + sophia. We'll capture decision timeline and metric deltas.

nina: CS notified and sent the prepared note to affected contacts.

jess: :thumbsup: Updating release notes: added entry "v3.5.3 partial rollback (canary) — investigating quant-opt kernel flag" and tagging the release.

matt: Thanks everyone. Leaving the incident open for 2 hours to validate stability, then we'll close if metrics stay healthy.
